svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure token-refresh, split out of session-lifecycle.yaml: the 401 round trip of the axios # response interceptor with its three exits to endSession. Every edge is inferred from call sites. title: Token refresh on a 401 in the SPA subtitle: The first 401 triggers one refresh with one-use rotation and a retry; any failure goes through endSession kind: flowchart direction: down layout: { spacing: 2 } groups: lane-spa: { type: lane, label: SPA, evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:278-339" } lane-be: { type: lane, label: Backend, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:24" } nodes: signedin: shape: terminator label: Signed in in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:74-77" # user and tokens installed active: shape: process label: Serve authenticated requests in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:74-77" got401: shape: decision label: Response is a 401? in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:322-332" refresh: shape: data label: POST /api/auth/refresh note: one-use rotation in: lane-spa evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:284-302", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:48-56"] rotate: shape: process label: Consume refresh, issue pair note: reuse after 60 s grace revokes all sessions in: lane-be evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_refresh.py:84-108", "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_refresh.py:31"] retry: shape: process label: Store tokens, retry request in: lane-spa evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:301", "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:334-339"] note: keeps the same session generation end: shape: predefined label: endSession note: "clearSessionData, exit demo, log out store" in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:50-54" signedout: shape: terminator label: Signed out in: lane-spa evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:52-53" edges: - signedin -> active: { evidence: "frontend/src/hooks/api/useAuth.ts:74-77" } - active -> got401: { label: API error, evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:316" } - got401 -> active: { label: "no", evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:327" } - got401 -> refresh: { label: "yes, first time", evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:334-336" } - got401 -> end: { label: "yes, after retry", evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:329-332" } - refresh -> rotate: { evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/auth.py:56#refresh_tokens" } - refresh -> end: { label: no refresh token, evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:287-289" } - rotate -> retry: { label: new pair, evidence: "frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:296-302" } - rotate -> end: { label: invalid or reused, evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:303-306", "backend/src/ledger_sync/services/auth_refresh.py:96-108"] } - retry -> active: { evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:337-339", "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:15"] } - end -> signedout: { evidence: "frontend/src/lib/session.ts:50-54" }

svg.title: Token refresh on a 401 in the SPA
svg.desc: Token refresh on a 401 in the SPA. 8 components in 2 groups. Connections: Signed in to Serve authenticated requests; Serve authenticated requests to Response is a 401? (API error); Response is a 401? to Serve authenticated requests (no); Response is a 401? to POST /api/auth/refresh (yes, first time); Response is a 401? to endSession (yes, after retry); POST /api/auth/refresh to Consume refresh, issue pair; POST /api/auth/refresh to endSession (no refresh token); Consume refresh, issue pair to Store tokens, retry request (new pair); Consume refresh, issue pair to endSession (invalid or reused); Store tokens, retry request to Serve authenticated requests; endSession to Signed out.

text.tspan: TOKEN REFRESH ON A 401 IN THE SPA
